{{TAG:0003:0026:}}En tout cas, {{TAG:0005:0008:}},{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} merci de

{{TAG:0005:0008:}}!

{{TAG:0005:0008:}}!

FR:
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Ha ha !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Mais bon, ce qui compte,

{{TAG:0003:0002:}}Ah ah!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Quello che conta è

la carta da regalo!{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Grazie per la consegna, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!

Du coup{{TAG:0003:0000:}}... {{TAG:0003:000B:}}Hmm... Suivant la façon

{{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

! Sağ ol, {{TAG:0005:0008:}}!
